name: Buzz Session #3: Bjarke Ingels + Simon Frommenwiler
description:
We are thrilled to announce that Bjarke Ingels & Simon Frommenwiler, representing their respective offices BIG - Bjarke Ingels Group & HHF Architects, are the two architectural curators for the 2019 edition of the Embassy's 'Architecture in Residence' program! 

Under the concept 'Open Embassy', the Swiss Embassy in Denmark has made it its mission to promote design, architecture and art as cultural and economic fields of cooperation between Switzerland and Denmark. Architecture in Residence acts as a platform for exchange to strengthen the relations between Danish and Swiss architects, architecture schools and producers from the building industry. 

During the Session the two architects will talk about their site-specific installation at the Embassy, as well as touch upon collaborative aspects of modern architecture.

Participants:

Bjarke Ingels: 
Founder and Partner at BIG (Bjarke Ingels Group). Bjarke was named one of the 100 Most Influential People in the World by TIME magazine. With his firm he is designing and completing award winning buildings globally, including the Two World Trade Centre in New York and recently opened 'Copenhill' in Copenhagen.

Simon Frommenwiler:
Founder and Partner at HHF Architects. Simon has had various high profile teaching assignments at ETH Lausanne, ENSA Strasbourg, Massachusetts Institute of Technology and since 2018 he is a visiting Professor at world renowned Harvard Graduate School of Design. 

SPECIAL GUEST
Bjørnstjerne Christiansen:
Co-founder of the danish artist group SUPERFLEX. They describe their artworks as tools - thereby suggesting multiple areas of application and use. SUPERFLEX have gained international recognition for their projects. They have had solo exhibitions, among others, at the Kunsthalle Basel in Switzerland. 

This Buzz Session is moderated by Ane Cortzen who is a Danish TV personality, architect and graphic designer, and the host of several Danish TV Series. 

We hope to see you at this special event!
